title: FUSE Mod Definition
description: Human-readable JSON form of a FUSE map mod. BSON uses the same logical model.

schemaVersion.description: FUSE data schema version. This drives migrations and is separate from modVersion. Use the string form, for example "1.0"; integer 1 remains accepted for v1.0 compatibility.

author.description: Optional author string. Converted legacy packages may leave this blank when the source manifest did not name an author.

tags.description: Package-level tags. Runtime-converted compatibility packages include legacy-converted so they can be identified and retired later.

map.description: Declares that this package provides a selectable map. The map id is the package id. Map-package content applies only when its map is the active session map.

mixinto.description: Optional legacy conditional mixinto metadata. FUSE applies this fragment only when its requirements are satisfied, matching RailLoader/Strange Customs conditional mixins.

settings.description: Package-declared FUSE settings. Runtime values are stored outside the mod folder and scoped by user, profile, or server profile.

featureRules.description: Native FUSE rules that include authored objects only when a package setting matches. Rules are evaluated on map/package load.

extensions.description: Namespaced extension data. Use reverse-DNS keys, for example com.example.tool.

displayName.description: Name shown wherever the map is offered for selection. Falls back to the package name when blank.

mapFolder.description: Package-relative folder shaped like StreamingAssets/Maps/<name>: Map.json (origin, tileDimension, tiles) plus tile_XXX_YYY.data heightmap tiles. Must stay inside the package folder.

suppressBaseWorld.description: When true, the stock Bushnell/Whittier track graph, operations, scenery, labels, signs, setups, progression, and CTC content are suppressed before this complete map package applies. Set false only for an intentional terrain overlay on the stock world.

target.description: Legacy mixinto target name such as game-graph, progressions, scenery, splineys, horns, whistles, or bells.

sourceFile.description: Legacy source file that produced this FUSE fragment.

conflictsWith.description: Legacy conditional incompatibilities. The fragment is skipped when any matching package/version is enabled; the rest of the package remains active.

id.description: Legacy or FUSE package id that must be installed. A converted package id ending in .FUSE also satisfies the original legacy id.

settings.description: Dictionary of package setting definitions keyed by stable setting id.

default.description: Default value used when no persisted value exists. Its JSON type should match the setting type.

values.description: Exact enum values. FUSE preserves these strings and does not normalize identifiers.

featureRules.description: Dictionary of stable feature-rule ids. A false rule omits all named targets until the next map/package reload.

setting.description: Id of a setting declared by this package. The setting should set reloadRequired=true.

value.description: Comparison value. Its JSON type should match the referenced setting.

trackRemovals.description: Exact graph object IDs to remove. For base-game track, use Railroader's raw track graph IDs, not UI labels such as siding, spur, station, or industry names.

nodes.description: TrackNode IDs to remove. Base-game node IDs are usually short alphanumeric graph IDs.

segments.description: TrackSegment IDs to remove exactly as they appear in the graph.

spans.description: TrackSpan IDs to remove exactly as they appear in the graph.

isDiamond.description: Marks this node as one half of a diamond crossing. FUSE preserves it on game versions that expose diamond-node routing.

gauge.description: Optional NarrowGaugeMod segment metadata. FUSE stores the value for companion mods; Railroader's base graph still uses the normal track geometry.

bridgeSupportsSteel.description: Use steel bridge supports when style is bridge. Older Railroader builds that only expose the four-way style enum retain bridge style but cannot represent this extra distinction.

yard.description: Marks the segment as yard track independently of bridge/tunnel structure on Railroader builds that expose combinable track flags. The legacy style value 'yard' remains supported.

partial.description: When true, this entry patches an existing runtime segment; the preserve* flags select which fields keep their current runtime value instead of being overwritten.

preserveStyle.description: In a partial patch, keep the existing segment style instead of overwriting it.

preserveBridgeSupportsSteel.description: In a partial patch, keep the existing bridge-support material flag.

preserveYard.description: In a partial patch, keep the existing independent yard flag.

preserveTrackClass.description: In a partial patch, keep the existing trackClass instead of overwriting it.

preserveSpeedLimit.description: In a partial patch, keep the existing speedLimit instead of overwriting it.

preservePriority.description: In a partial patch, keep the existing priority instead of overwriting it.

preserveGroupId.description: In a partial patch, keep the existing groupId instead of overwriting it.

end.description: Which segment end the normalized or distance value is measured from. A/Start points toward the segment end; B/End points toward the segment start. Span endpoint arrows must face each other.

order.description: Signed display sort key. Lower values appear earlier; legacy conversions may preserve negative source order values.

operationRemovals.description: FUSE-id removals for operations objects. Use this to carry source JSON null entries through conversion.

carTypeFilter.description: Comma-delimited car-type filter expression, matched verbatim per token at runtime — write "FB,XM", not "FB, XM" (a token with surrounding whitespace can never match). A token may end with * to match any car type whose code starts with that prefix; a bare * (or omitting the field) matches any car type.

fields.description: Optional reflection-bound field/property values for custom Load implementations supplied by separate mods.

order.description: Signed display sort key within the area. Lower values appear earlier; legacy conversions may preserve negative source order values.

mergeComponents.description: When true, component entries patch existing runtime components and do not remove components omitted from this definition. Intended for compatibility-converted fragments.

replaceComponents.description: When true, components is the complete intended set for this industry and any pre-existing runtime sub-components not listed here are removed. Set by the legacy converter when a mod uses the "$replace" directive at the top of its source components dictionary.

remove.description: When true, this entry is a deletion request for an existing runtime component rather than an add/update, and may omit type/name. Emitted by the legacy converter for the Strange Customs "<name>": null component-removal idiom.

partial.description: When true, this entry patches an existing runtime component and may omit type/name. Partial span arrays are appended to the current component spans unless trackSpanPatch specifies a different list operation.

type.description: Built-in FUSE component type such as loader, unloader, formulaic, repairTrack, teamTrack, interchange, interchangedLoader, interchangedUnloader, teleportLoading, progression, passengerStop, or a fully-qualified custom IndustryComponent type. Known legacy custom shortcuts such as ConfusingSupplements CaptiveConversionLoader, CaptiveConversionUnloader, Pay4Resource, and Empty are normalized to their fully-qualified component types.

trackSpanPatch.description: Compatibility list patch for component track spans. Replaces, prepends, appends/inserts, or removes span ids without flattening operation semantics.

carTypeFilter.description: Comma-delimited car-type filter expression, matched verbatim per token at runtime — write "FB,XM", not "FB, XM" (a token with surrounding whitespace can never match). A token may end with * to match any car type whose code starts with that prefix; a bare * (or omitting the field) matches any car type.

fields.description: Optional reflection-bound field/property values for custom community IndustryComponent implementations supplied by separate mods.

carTypeFilter.description: Comma-delimited car-type filter expression, matched verbatim per token at runtime — write "FB,XM", not "FB, XM" (a token with surrounding whitespace can never match). A token may end with * to match any car type whose code starts with that prefix; a bare * (or omitting the field) matches any car type.

legacyIdentifier.description: Optional legacy turntable identifier used to reproduce existing helper node and roundhouse segment IDs.

pitAssetIdentifier.description: Optional scenery asset identifier for a static custom pit visual.

bridgeAssetIdentifier.description: Optional scenery asset identifier for a bridge visual that rotates with the turntable.

bridgeTrackEnabled.description: Whether the rotating bridge carries a drivable track segment. Defaults to true.

bridgeTrackGauge.description: Gauge of the bridge track in meters. Defaults to 1.435 (standard gauge).

bridgeTrackLength.description: Length of the bridge track. Defaults to 0, in which case it is derived from the turntable radius.

bridgeTrackYOffset.description: Vertical offset applied to the bridge track. Defaults to 0.08.

controllerType.description: Optional assembly-qualified MonoBehaviour type implementing FUSE.API.IFuseTurntableController.

spawnPoints.description: Custom player/consist spawn points registered as Railroader Character.SpawnPoint components.

waterSurfaces.description: FUSE-owned lake polygons built from world-space boundary points and loaded Railroader water assets.

telegraphPoleMovements.description: Offsets existing base-game telegraph pole graph nodes by node index/id. Covers legacy TelegraphPoleMover data without creating a new pole set.

suppressBaseScenePaths.description: Base-game scene paths to hide or disable when this package applies.

suppressBaseTrackGroups.description: Base-game track group IDs to suppress when this package applies.

suppressBaseAreas.description: Base-game area IDs to suppress when this package applies.

suppressScenePaths.description: Deprecated alias for suppressBaseScenePaths. FUSE normalizes it on load.

suppressGroups.description: Deprecated alias for suppressBaseTrackGroups. FUSE normalizes it on load.

suppressAreas.description: Deprecated alias for suppressBaseAreas. FUSE normalizes it on load.

worldRemovals.description: Scene-path or FUSE-id removals for world objects. Use this to carry source JSON null entries through conversion.

model.description: Deprecated v1.0 compatibility field. If assetIdentifier is missing, FUSE treats model as the asset identifier and logs one deprecation warning per package.

anchorSpanIds.description: Optional track spans used as anchors. FUSE positions the scenery at the average span center, aligns it to the average span tangent, then applies position/rotation as offsets.

offsetY.description: Vertical offset passed through to Railroader's RiverPath. Converted Strange Customs FlowyThingBuilder entries should emit -0.1 when the legacy source omits this field.

assetIdentifier.description: Scenery asset repeated by an objectLine spline. Mutually exclusive with prefab.

prefab.description: Prefab URI such as path://scene/World/... repeated by an objectLine spline. Mutually exclusive with assetIdentifier.

sourceLakePath.description: Optional scene path whose LakePolygon profile/material should be reused.

materialName.description: Optional exact loaded material name. When omitted, FUSE uses the source or a loaded stock water material.

rotation.description: Always emitted by the serializer because every mask shares one model shape. Unused for circles; defaults to {0,0,0}.

falloff.description: Blend distance at mask edge. Defaults to 0.

enableSetHeight.description: Flatten terrain to a fixed height. Defaults to false.

enableCutTrees.description: Clear trees within mask. Defaults to true.

enableMaskModifier.description: Activate mask modifier. Defaults to true.

order.description: Evaluation order among masks. Defaults to 0.

falloff.description: Blend distance at mask edge. Defaults to 0.

enableSetHeight.description: Flatten terrain to a fixed height. Defaults to false.

enableCutTrees.description: Clear trees within mask. Defaults to true.

enableMaskModifier.description: Activate mask modifier. Defaults to true.

order.description: Evaluation order among masks. Defaults to 0.

center.description: Always emitted by the serializer because every mask shares one model shape. Unused for curves (the path is defined by points); defaults to {0,0,0}.

rotation.description: Always emitted by the serializer because every mask shares one model shape. Unused for curves; defaults to {0,0,0}.

falloff.description: Blend distance at mask edge. Defaults to 0.

enableSetHeight.description: Flatten terrain to a fixed height. Defaults to false.

enableCutTrees.description: Clear trees within mask. Defaults to true.

enableMaskModifier.description: Activate mask modifier. Defaults to true.

order.description: Evaluation order among masks. Defaults to 0.

directory.description: MapManager.directoryName this tile source extends, for example BushnellWhittier.

sourceFolder.description: Package-relative folder that contains tile_XXX_YYY.data files. Absolute paths are supported for local migration workflows.

priority.description: Higher-priority sources override lower-priority sources when they provide the same tile coordinate.

clip.description: Path to a loose WAV/MP3/OGG/AIFF file, relative to the FUSE package folder.

progressionId.description: Default runtime Progression.identifier for root sections. If omitted, FUSE uses the package id.

sections.description: Flat authoring form for narrative progression sections. FUSE normalizes these into progressions.<progressionId>.sections at load time.

baseProgression.description: Optional existing progression to inherit sections and Company start features from. Custom sections with the same id override inherited sections.

enableFeaturesAtStart.description: Map features force-enabled every time this progression is configured in Company mode. Mirrors the game's Progression.enableFeaturesAtStart: on every load the game calls SetFeatureEnabled(feature, true) for each entry, so the enable is persisted into the save and self-heals existing saves. Never fires in sandbox. Array form replaces the list; object form ({"id": true}) merges per id — use the object form when patching a base-game progression (e.g. "ewh") so its own start features (wh-el, ewh-intch) are preserved.

id.description: Required for progression.sections[]; optional when the section is keyed inside progressions.*.sections.

progressionId.description: Optional override for root sections. Defaults to progression.progressionId or the package id.

prerequisiteSections.description: Alias for prerequisiteSectionIds; preferred for new root section authoring.

prerequisiteSectionIds.description: Legacy keyed-section prerequisite field. FUSE also accepts prerequisiteSections.

unlockIncludeIndustries.description: Section-level unlock payload. FUSE materializes this through a synthetic MapFeature enabled when the section unlocks.

unlockExcludeIndustries.description: Section-level unlock payload. FUSE materializes this through a synthetic MapFeature enabled when the section unlocks.

unlockIncludeIndustryComponents.description: Section-level unlock payload. FUSE materializes this through a synthetic MapFeature enabled when the section unlocks.

areasEnableOnUnlock.description: Section-level unlock payload. FUSE materializes this through a synthetic MapFeature enabled when the section unlocks.

gameObjectsEnableOnUnlock.description: Scene paths to enable when this section unlocks.

trackGroupsEnableOnUnlock.description: Track groups to enable when this section unlocks.

trackGroupsAvailableOnUnlock.description: Track groups to mark available when this section unlocks.

interchangeTransfers.description: Maps a source Interchange industry component id to a destination Interchange component id. Null or blank targets are preserved as no-op legacy entries.

industryComponentId.description: ProgressionIndustryComponent to activate while this delivery phase is pending. Required when deliveries is not empty.

carTypeFilter.description: Comma-delimited car-type filter expression, matched verbatim per token at runtime — write "FB,XM", not "FB, XM" (a token with surrounding whitespace can never match). A token may end with * to match any car type whose code starts with that prefix; a bare * (or omitting the field) matches any car type.

groupIds.description: Compatibility shortcut. If explicit trackGroups* arrays are absent, this fills both enable and available group arrays.

idPatch.description: An id list in either FuseStringPatch form: an array replaces the runtime list; an object of {"id": boolean} merges per id (true adds, false removes, anything else is kept).
